SlideMate 0.4.3 makes Send to iPad find your iPad even when its name isn't typed exactly.

### Fixes
- **Auto-select finds your iPad despite small differences in its name**: a different apostrophe (‘ ’ '), spaces
  (`iPadPro2022` vs `iPad Pro 2022`) or capital letters. SlideMate sends to the iPad AirDrop shows, and saves that
  spelling in Settings → Send to iPad so it's instant next time.
- If it still can't find your iPad, the message now lists the iPads AirDrop can see, so you can copy the right name.

### Install
Already on 0.3 or 0.4? SlideMate offers this update by itself (or choose SlideMate → **Check for Updates…**).

New here: download **SlideMate-0.4.3-macOS.zip** below, unzip it, and drag SlideMate into Applications. First open:
macOS 15+: System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**; macOS 13–14: right-click → **Open**. The app isn't
notarised yet.
